# youtubemp3.sbs

## Free YouTube to MP3 Converter

Convert YouTube videos to high-quality MP3 audio instantly. Free, fast, no ads, no signup required.

### Features

- Convert YouTube videos to MP3 (audio)
- High-quality output (up to 320kbps audio)
- Automatic album art embedding for MP3 files
- No registration required
- No ads or popups
- Fast conversion using yt-dlp
- Instant download after conversion

### How to Use

1. Paste a YouTube video URL into the input field
2. Click Convert
3. Wait for the conversion to complete
4. Download your MP3 file

- [Home](https://youtubemp3.sbs/)
